name: Shoji Reveal
description: Paper screens on wooden lattices that slide apart, overlapping as they go, to show what is behind them.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the screens are opened or closed from inside the component.

props.name: trigger
props.description: What opens the screens: pressing them, the pointer coming over the frame (closing when it leaves), or the frame scrolling into view. The screens can always be pressed or toggled from the keyboard.

props.name: panels
props.description: Number of screens. Half slide to each side, the inner ones over the outer ones.

props.name: openLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the screens while closed.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the screens while open.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the frame. Give it a size; the content fills it.

props.name: children
props.description: What is behind the screens. It shows through the paper as soft shapes and cannot be focused until the screens open.
